A '''Wookiee passenger''' once traveled with the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] company during the early stages of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During their journey, the Wookiee got startled when a [[Human/Legends|Human]] child took a picture of them without warning.<ref name="ST2" />

==Biography==
At some point in the early [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] passenger once traveled aboard a [[StarSpeeder 1000]] chartered by the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] travel agency. When the Wookiee tourist boarded the [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]], he or she took a seat between a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Unidentified Mon Calamari passenger|passenger]] and an elderly [[Gender/Legends|female]]. Shortly before departure, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]] sitting in front of them used a [[Camera/Legends|camera]] to take a picture of the two [[Alien/Legends|non-Humans]]. As the flash option was activated, the Wookiee and the Mon Calamari were blinded by the sudden burst of light. While the startled Wookiee tourist threw their arms up in the air in displeasure, the child's mother reprimanded her son. That event was later immortalized when it was included on the safety video Star Tours showed to their passengers before taking off<ref name="ST2" /> between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[1 BBY/Legends|1]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="ST2 date">According to [[Star Wars Insider 127|''Star Wars Insider'' 127]] [[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' takes place between [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. In the attraction's queue, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[G2-9T/Legends|G2-9T]] refers to the secret base of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. According to {{FactFile|132|VAS 3-4|The Yavin Vassilika}}, the Rebels only acquired the key to the Great Temple in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. The attraction must therefore take place after that.</ref>

==Personality and traits==
The [[Color/Legends|colors]] of the passenger's [[Hair/Legends|fur]] varied from black to chestnut brown,<ref name="ST2" /> demonstrating their belonging to the [[rwook]] [[Species/Legends|subspecies]] of Wookiees.<ref name="CSWE" /> The tourist wore an ammunition [[bandolier]] across the [[Breast/Legends|breast]], and their torso also bore<ref name="ST2" /> a pentagonal clanic symbol.<ref name="ROSV">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The unidentified Wookiee passenger appears in the pre-boarding video of ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'',<ref name="ST2" /> a [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney]] [[Wikipedia:Simulator ride|simulator ride]] [[Wikipedia:Amusement park|theme park]] attraction located at [[Disneyland]] in [[Wikipedia:California|California]], [[Disney's Hollywood Studios]] at [[Wikipedia:Walt Disney World Resort|Walt Disney World]] in [[Wikipedia:Florida|Florida]], and [[Tokyo Disneyland]].<ref name="StarToursReturns">{{SWArchive|url=fans/events/news20090912/index.html|text=A Re-Imagined Star Tours to Blast Off in California and Florida in 2011}}</ref> The color pattern of the Wookiee tourist's hair is similar<ref name="ST2" /> to that of [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], the Wookiee protagonist of the ''Star Wars'' [[original trilogy]].<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref>
